# C# generated by Runic Translations 0.8.0

These files are the output of the 0.8.0 generator for the catalog in
`GeneratedCSharpSnapshotTests` (`v0.8.0:tests/fixtures/translations/generated-csharp`). They are frozen: never
regenerate them. `Runic.Translations.Runtime.Tests` compiles them against the current runtime and runs them
(`PreviousGeneratorTests`), which checks that this runtime still runs the ABIs of 0.8.0-generated code. The version
rule promises that code generated by release N runs on runtime N or later within the same minor before 1.0 (the same
major from 1.0); 0.8.0 libraries have an open dependency range, so they reach later runtimes. Add the output of a later release beside this directory when its generated code changes.
